accelerated_output_note: Present only when the accelerated output arm was staged. The accelerated timing arm is not a wall claim; this section is an output-parity check against the candidate ordinary set.

declared_null_band_pct.note: Largest |per-pair delta %| produced by two *identical* arms (baseline vs baseline) under the same interleaving. A candidate delta inside this band is indistinguishable from the instrument's own noise; it is not a measured regression.

probe_note: Host-side `t135-batch` lines, candidate arm only, filtered to the occupancy batch (`miter_some=0`, positive delta). `thread_ms` is the sum of per-request durations (conversion + clipper), `wall_ms` the whole host call; the ratio is the batch's own fan-out. It includes IR<->WIT conversion on both sides, so it is not directly comparable to t134's clipper-only 14,169 ms.

disclosures.note: The strict forms are the gate as first written, before this take measured the box's own paired noise. They are reported so the record shows both readings; the declared gate is the null-controlled one above.
